summary.what_it_does: The page is a copy of a Google Doc titled 'A Guide to Writing Prompts for Text-to-image AI'. The meta description says that details left out of a prompt will be randomized, so vague prompts give variety while specific prompts give more control. It advises stating important context or details clearly. The visible text is mostly Google Docs interface elements (menus, language lists, sharing options), so the guide's body content is not captured in the extracted text.
notable: Explains that unspecified details in a prompt are randomized by the generator
Covers the trade-off between vague prompts (variety) and specific prompts (control)
Listed in eudk/awesome-ai-tools under 'Tools for better image prompting'
caveats: Only the meta description and interface text were available; the full guide body was not extracted
Document is a copy of an original guide, and its author is not named on the page
